title: Conversation rules need genuine agreement

captions.physics: Discovering an obligatory rule lacks confirmation
captions.emotions: Feeling steadiness in an accepted arrangement

meaning: You can discover that an obligatory conversational rule lacks confirmation and clarify conditions for speaking freely, feeling steadiness in an arrangement genuinely accepted by both.
text: The Tower in the physical position of your Vishuddha reveals that a supposedly obligatory conversational rule was never confirmed. The Devil in energy here supports honestly clarifying a binding condition: what the right to object apparently depends on. The Emperor in emotions brings steadiness through an understandable arrangement. You can want a reliable form of conversation while discovering that it had never actually been accepted by both. Order gains a basis in actual consent rather than the force of a familiar formula.

For example, a comment about a story meets “We always start with praise”. Clarification reveals there was no joint decision about this. The obligatory rule’s basis collapses. **A steady conversation allows objection without buying permission**. You name the condition under which criticism supposedly earns a place through praise and discuss actual willingness to listen. Certainty can emerge without forbidding warmth: praise remains possible but stops being payment for the right to differ.

Difficulty appears if the distinction becomes an opposite rigid rule: every compliment before a comment is now declared insincere. A sense of order then rests on restricted answers again. The constructive side of the Devil helps notice binding conditions without assigning a hidden motive to every word. You can value a clear conversational form and preserve freedom in the sequence of remarks; removing compulsory praise makes voluntary warmth neither suspicious nor less meaningful.
